get_parquet_files: get the exported parquet files for a HuggingFace dataset using the datasets-server API
get_dataset_infos: get the dataset information and features for a HuggingFace dataset using the datasets-server API
handle_dataset_viewer_error: handle DatasetViewerError exceptions raised when accessing missing or unavailable datasets on HuggingFace
check_parquet_export_status: check if a dataset parquet export is ready, not pending, and not failed before downloading
validate_dataset_revision: validate that the dataset info or parquet export matches the expected commit hash revision
